    ('ru', 'readme_gameplay_desc', 'Уничтожайте врагов, набирайте очки и пройдите 20 секторов. В каждом секторе идут заданные волны атак со всё более опасными схемами поведения врагов. Собирайте бонусы: дополнительные жизни, щиты и самонаводящиеся ракеты. Используйте кредиты в меню улучшений, чтобы навсегда усилить корабль.'),

    ('zh-CN', 'gameover_retry_hint', 'R / Enter = 重试 · Esc = 菜单'),

def sha(s: str) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(s.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()

src = GAME.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
if sha(src) != BASE_SHA:
    raise SystemExit(f'Unexpected current SPACE RAID build: {sha(src)}')
m = PATTERN.search(src)
if not m:
    raise SystemExit('Translations payload not found')
translations = json.loads(m.group(1))
work = src[:m.start()] + PLACEHOLDER + src[m.end():]
if sha(work) != PLACEHOLDER_SHA:
    raise SystemExit('Baseline placeholder hash mismatch')
parts = work.splitlines(keepends=True)
for i1, i2, new_text in reversed(OPS):
    parts[i1:i2] = new_text.splitlines(keepends=True)
work = ''.join(parts)
for lang, key, value in TRANSLATION_UPDATES:
    translations.setdefault(lang, {})[key] = value
payload = json.dumps(translations, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':'))
translation_script = '<script>window.__SPACE_RAID_TRANSLATIONS__=' + payload + ';</script>'
target = work.replace(PLACEHOLDER, translation_script, 1)
if sha(target) != TARGET_SHA:
    raise SystemExit(f'Final SPACE RAID hash mismatch: {sha(target)}')
GAME.write_text(target, encoding='utf-8')
print('SPACE RAID 2093 polished build reconstructed exactly:', TARGET_SHA)

INDEX = Path('index.html')
BASE_INDEX_SHA = '34f6806912a04f2c6d90ab9d7d3fb3367fbf8f1c5c115fb4b20f2444bc47a9d4'
TARGET_INDEX_SHA = 'bf88c3f1d10a5bcb2283c430062bb95406d3e95609f9dc9da7719a42aafc663a'
index_src = INDEX.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
if sha(index_src) != BASE_INDEX_SHA:
    raise SystemExit(f'Unexpected current hub build: {sha(index_src)}')
old_card = "{file:'space_raid_2093.html',id:'space_raid_2093',name:'SPACE RAID 2093',emoji:'🚀',desc:'Shooter espacial de campanha com 20 fases, upgrades persistentes e arsenal especial.',new:true},"
new_card = "{file:'space_raid_2093.html',id:'space_raid_2093',name:'SPACE RAID 2093',emoji:'🚀',desc:'Shooter espacial de campanha com 20 setores, paleta Spectrum 2093, upgrades persistentes, arsenal especial e replay instantâneo.',new:true},"
spectrum_css = '''\n/* SPACE RAID 2093 — Spectrum 2093 hub identity */\n.game-card[data-game="space_raid_2093"]{border-color:#66C2A548;box-shadow:0 18px 58px #0a0718aa,0 0 0 1px #E6F59818}.game-card[data-game="space_raid_2093"]:hover{border-color:#E6F598aa;box-shadow:0 24px 75px #0008,0 0 34px #66C2A532}.game-card[data-game="space_raid_2093"] .thumb-art{background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 54%,#FFFFBF30 0 7%,transparent 24%),radial-gradient(circle at 22% 26%,#D53E4F42,transparent 30%),radial-gradient(circle at 76% 30%,#3288BD48,transparent 32%),radial-gradient(circle at 62% 82%,#66C2A542,transparent 30%),linear-gradient(145deg,#100d1c,#281631 52%,#172d49)}.game-card[data-game="space_raid_2093"] .thumb-art::after{border-color:#E6F59838;box-shadow:0 0 0 24px #66C2A50c,0 0 0 49px #FDAE6109,0 0 42px #3288BD35}.game-card[data-game="space_raid_2093"] .glyph{filter:drop-shadow(0 12px 18px #000a) drop-shadow(0 0 18px #FEE08B66)}\n'''
marker = '.game-card[data-game="alien_threat"]{border-color:#78ff4b40'
if index_src.count(old_card) != 1 or index_src.count(marker) != 1:
    raise SystemExit('Hub anchors did not match expected canonical build')
index_target = index_src.replace(old_card, new_card, 1).replace(marker, spectrum_css + marker, 1)
if sha(index_target) != TARGET_INDEX_SHA:
    raise SystemExit(f'Final hub hash mismatch: {sha(index_target)}')
INDEX.write_text(index_target, encoding='utf-8')
print('Quickplay hub updated exactly:', TARGET_INDEX_SHA)
